<@ba.rem>Can store 1 charge</>

runtimeMapping.ownerAttack: Original ordinary PHYSICAL RangedAttack CAST0 selects one target at release; original Front/Back Attack .267/cap2, source logic projectile speed10 and5s lifetime/unmanaged/stopWhenSourceInvalid0. Current legal impact checks retain ordinary Sleep/free/hidden restrictions without rechecking owner range; born projectile survives source control/removal. No extra INPUT snapshot is invented for CAST0 beyond shared launched projectile identity. blkngt_tr ON_CALCULATE_DAMAGE checks actual own token blocker and scales outgoing amount by selected trait1.5 before DEF without inventing an IsAttack predicate.
runtimeMapping.stock: Owner charge_token[born] cnt1; source point consumes DP0/slot0, no facing, ground only within owner attack range, single point. Original own elite/level stats and interval20/17/15 are retained. Defeat/manual retreat rests the same point; no replacement stock is fabricated. Owner ON_FINISH removes point. A scoped owner ON_DEPLOY handler restores the exact born cnt1 after shared stockLimit controller initializes0; generic summon controllers are unchanged.
runtimeMapping.pointLifecycle: Native four modes Recharge0/Default1/Sleep2/Skill3, category switch on fatal, exact retained rage and S2 buff IDs, explicit ReBorn ability waitEvent0/timeMode2/preDelay1/cooldown1 maps Start1 and full HP. Recharge interval20/17/15 then one-second rebirth; zero block/immunity/target-free in recharge and block1/HealFree in active modes. Born uses the same one-second explicit ReBorn, not an invented second deploy delay.
runtimeMapping.s1: Original manual Sequence and literal Skill_1 .167 event; DP11 and eligible non-recharging point enters mode2, selected additive maxHP-ratio regen for10s. Non-derived INFINITY sleep wrapper is independent of regen: regen expiry does not wake. Source mode2 does not set SLEEPING/invulnerability/noBlock, so point remains targetable/block1 and cannot attack. Positive incoming damage modifier clears wrapper+regen; bounded nonlethal comparison enables mode1 selected ATK% and baseASPD-scaled percentage rage10s; starting S1 clears prior rage.
runtimeMapping.s2: Original literal Skill_2 .533 event grants DP4 and emits one purpose0 WALK Sleep pulse in original x-5 around the existing point, including recharging point. Selected4/5/6s Sleep independently expires and does not capture new entrants. Active point mode3 uses original Skill_2 .5 event and Arts attacks; its selected coefficient1.2..2.1 applies only to SLEEPING output recipients. S2 coefficient buff survives point rest and is checked by ReBorn; expiry restores default only if not recharging.
runtimeMapping.pointSelection: Original trigger29 gives sleeping-priority first input from x-5 normal range; normal physical CAST0 reacquires at .5. S2 actual MultiMeleeAttack selectTargetSource3/selectTargetTiming1/alwaysIncludeTarget1 and Sphere radius1.10000002384 are represented by a bounded input-position circle and eligible victim deployment list sampled at startup. The retained list is revalidated at .5: legal departed recipients remain, new entrants are excluded, hidden/dead/replaced/free/flying recipients are excluded. This is not a recovered native source3 enum or dispatcher proof.
runtimeMapping.control: Owner command locks normal attacks/SP through original literal clip and captures attackControlEpoch after intentional cast disarm. Sub-dt control/withdrawal cancels unborn command; emitted point modes/Sleep/regen have independent selected lifetimes. Token mode changes/rest interrupt unborn attack via scoped mode epoch; damage cannot be emitted from a prior mode or replacement deployment. Stored S2 charges cannot replace an unfinished source command; the next charge may cast after its full literal clip while a previous born token mode remains.
runtimeMapping.visual: Original single Slumberfoot animator PPtrs resolve Idle→Idle_2(inactive), active Idle_2→Idle_1, ReBorn→Start, active Die_2→Die_1 and S2 Attack→Skill_2. Owner facings are actual chararts-bound bytes. Core presentation uses literal source active/inactive/Sleep poses, without invented particles or missing Back art.

verificationLimits: No native executable C# dispatcher or frame parity is claimed. Exact source graphs, BB levels, original pointer bindings, byte hashes and selected contracts are retained together.

Source SelectTargetSource3 numeric position mapping and INPUT1 selection phase are unrecovered. Root-approved bounded mapping samples a radius1.1 circle around first trigger INPUT position and retains the initial selected eligible list; alwaysIncludeTarget1 includes that input independently of the radius. Tests distinguish input-centered from point-centered geometry, movement/death/hide/replacement and new entrants. This is not generic enum recovery.

Owner S1 Sequence alwaysNext/useLongestAbilityCooldown and both manual ApplyBuff waitEvent1/timeMode1 root/child/lifetime ordering are unrecovered. The explicit original OnAttack events .167/.533 are command release clocks; the full original clip locks attacks/SP, selected S1 duration10 holds ordinary skill SP, and emitted token buffs retain independent source durations. Native Sequence/FSM reentry and inherited duration start phases remain bounded.

Native LOWEST_PRIORITY sleep wrapper ON_TAKE_DAMAGE orders FinishBuff→CompareModifierValueWithTargetType LE HP/ignoreEs:false→SwitchMode/rage. The runtime bridges this at post-mitigation/pre-shield damageFinal using prehit HP, because executable shield/fatal/HP-floor ordering is unrecovered. Shielded positive accepted modifiers wake; canceled/missed/dodged/zero/gauge/HP-loss paths do not. Lethal greater-than-prehitHP clears wrapper without rage then rests. This is an explicit modifier-order interpretation, not a recovered native predicate.

ATTACK_SPEED MULTIPLIER rage is represented as baseASPD×selected percentage added to the existing additive ASPD channel, consistent with original100 baseline and independent primary calculator. Native aggregation with foreign ASPD percentage attributes is unrecovered; foreign additive ASPD remains additive and is tested.

Source postFilter29 / onlyIgnoreSomeOfTargetFreeCase Sleep exception is represented as sleeping priority and hitSleep without broad stealth/target-free/hidden bypass. Exact block-vs-special ordering and numeric target category/filter dispatcher are unrecovered.

Tactical category/fatal/rebirth trigger and retained-buff clocks are source-field bounded interpretations. The explicit interval and ReBorn1s are separate; direct scripted kill/removal bypasses the fatal rest. Exact native death-masking/frame boundary dispatcher remains unrecovered.

Owner source Attack_Down .167 exists only Front, while regular Attack .267 exists in both facings. Native down/highland facing selection cannot be recovered from the serialized animation key alone; the ordinary shared presentation uses actual Attack and its exact event, without claiming down-state parity.

Original animator mix Skill_Begin/Skill_End/Die_1 and Stun state transitions are retained, but the regular actor does not implement a native general control-state/mix dispatcher. Literal persistent Sleep/active/inactive/ReBorn/attack/die poses are presented; no original mix or stun one-shot parity is claimed.
Original Unity effects/audio identifiers are retained but particle/audio rendering is unsupported. Modules are not enabled.

S2 purposeNONE Sleep pulse uses the bounded non-ATTACK buff selection interpretation also used for reviewed beneficial/hostile auras: Invisible and existing Sleep do not borrow attack-specific rejection; living deployed WALK recipients exclude explicit target-free/hidden/air and honor Sleep immunity. enableAdvancedOptions0/ignoreTargetFreefalse alone do not recover a native Invisible dispatcher. Actual attacks still reject unrevealed Invisible.
